| Deploy on table. While Vader present at a Cloud City battleground site, {{Errata hl|1=your Force drain and Force drain bonuses at that site may not be canceled}}. Once per game, you may use 1 Force to {{Errata hl|1=▲ one Effect}} with “Bespin" or "Cloud City" in the game text. Place this Effect in Used Pile if Luke, Leia, Han, or Chewie wins a battle on Cloud City. {{Errata hl|1=(Immune to Alter.)}} || Deploy on table. {{Errata hl|1=It’s A Trap! may not be played}}. Once per game, may use 1 Force to {{Errata hl|1=▼ an Effect}} with “Bespin” or “Cloud City” {{Errata hl|1=in lore or game text}}. If Chewie, Han, Leia, or Luke wins a battle on Cloud City, place this Effect in Used Pile.
